description: Read the shared Tork ops handover. READ-ONLY. Call this at the start of a session, before touching any repo or database: it is the only way this account can see what the other Claude account did, what it decided, and which lane somebody has already claimed. Ids: 'current' (intent — decisions, blockers, ownership, next actions; written by a human at end of session), 'system' (facts — branch, uncommitted and unpushed counts, secret exposure, live endpoint status; regenerated by a post-commit hook), 'lessons' (recurring failures and the rule that prevents each), 'project:<name>' (per-project detail). Check updated_at before relying on it — a handover written days ago describes the estate as it was then.
name: get_handover
